metadata.title: DocApp
metadata.description: Deposit-based appointment booking for small clinics.

feedback.errorTitle: We could not load this page
feedback.errorDescription: Try again. If the problem continues, contact clinic support.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to continue to your DocApp account and manage your appointments.
signIn.securityNote: DocApp protects account access with secure authentication.
signIn.helpText: New here? Create an account from the registration page.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.description: Register as a patient to manage bookings, appointment status, deposits, and clinic cancellation requests.
signUp.privacyNote: Patient accounts are appointment-management only. Do not enter symptoms, diagnoses, treatment notes, or other medical-record details.
signUp.helpText: Clinic staff access is invitation-only. Staff should use the invitation link sent by the clinic.

home.title: Booking that clinics can trust
home.description: A focused foundation for clinic booking, appointment deposits, and recoverable Google Calendar sync.

patients.title: For patients
patients.description: Book with a clinic and keep appointment details in one place.
patients.item1: Choose a service and available appointment time
patients.item2: See the deposit due now and remaining clinic balance

clinics.title: For clinics
clinics.description: Create a calmer operational layer around clinic calendars.
clinics.item1: Configure services, doctors, rooms, and availability
clinics.item2: Track deposits, no-shows, and remaining balances
clinics.item3: Keep Google Calendar sync visible and recoverable

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.description: The accepted three-step booking wizard is now represented as a route foundation. Availability and booking behavior arrive in later phases.

service.title: Service
service.description: Choose the appointment type and provider.

details.title: Details
details.description: Confirm contact details and review the deposit.

admin.title: Operational overview
admin.description: The clinic administration shell is ready for organization-scoped operational features.

operations.title: Operational overview
operations.description: The admin surface will focus on clinic work, not marketing.

configuration.title: Clinic configuration
configuration.description: Settings will stay organization-scoped and role-protected.

patient.title: Your appointments
patient.description: The patient shell is ready for appointment ownership, status, and cancellation-request features.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: The patient area is appointment-management only.

privacy.title: Privacy boundary
privacy.description: Medical-record-like features remain outside the MVP.

support.title: Get the right help
support.description: The support route is ready for clinic and patient contact details when those settings are connected.

booking.title: Clinic booking support
booking.description: Patients should contact the clinic about appointment questions.

product.title: DocApp support
product.description: Clinic staff can contact DocApp for product assistance.

checkout.foundationDescription: The real order and appointment state will be loaded from the database in the payment phase.
checkout.item1: Status pages never mark orders paid
checkout.item2: Stripe webhooks are the payment source of truth
checkout.item3: Calendar creation happens only after confirmed payment

success.title: Appointment payment received
success.description: This read-only status page will show webhook-confirmed appointment and payment state.

pending.title: Payment is still processing
pending.description: This read-only status page will refresh from local order state without finalizing payment.

cancelled.title: Checkout was cancelled
cancelled.description: The appointment remains subject to server-side expiry and cleanup rules.

expired.title: Checkout has expired
expired.description: Expired pending appointments will become available again through server-side rules.
